headline: Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts Roar; Farranac Coast Rekindles
war_summary: Since the last edition the heaviest fire has shifted again. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest front, with eight strategic-base events in the past two hours and eleven in six; Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn are again the busiest ground. Godcrofts has burst into action, recording five events in two hours and seventeen on the day. Farranac Coast has woken, with four events in two hours after a quieter spell. Stonecradle also shows fresh movement, three events in two hours at The Long Fast. Kings Cage has traded blows at the latest hour, though its two-hour tally stands at two. Weathered Expanse, so loud at the last bulletin, has gone quiet in the past two hours after six events in six and thirty-seven in a day; the death toll there remains enormous. Callahan's Passage continues to sleep. DeadLands, Fisherman's Row, and Linn Mercy show no recent flips. No victory has been declared.
